responsiveness_rationale: Every part the question asks for is present somewhere in the returned rows, with the unit, the subject the quantity hangs on and the observed or calculated status carried as fields: the earthquake depths appear as bounded intervals in kilometres marked measured, attached to the ridge and to the short central segment, and the primary melt carbon dioxide content appears as a bounded interval in weight percent marked calculated and derived or estimated, attached to the primary melts and to that same segment. Two things stop this being a clean answer. The rows never express the association itself: the depth quantities and the melt composition quantities arrive under separate subjects with nothing in any row joining them, so the reader has to make the pairing the question asks about. And each side arrives in several mutually different variants, depth intervals taken from different passages and carbon dioxide intervals split between pre-eruptive and primary melts and between the rubidium and the barium proxy, with nothing in the row set marking which pair is the reported one. Alongside them sit rows that carry nothing the question asked for, since the binding is type-only and unfiltered. The rows therefore address every requested part but carry material ambiguity about which values answer it.
